failures.title: BMW B58B30M0 Engine Problems - What Actually Fails

items.title: Coolant Leaks (Water Pump & Expansion Tank) - 2015-Present models
items.whatHappens: The plastic impeller in the electric water pump can crack, and the coolant expansion tank is prone to developing hairline cracks or seal failures. This leads to gradual coolant loss, overheating warnings, and, if ignored, potential thermal damage to the cylinder head or turbocharger.
items.repairVsReplace: A standalone water pump and expansion tank replacement costs £500-£1,000 . If overheating has caused warped components or head gasket failure, a full BMW B58B30M0 engine replacement is the only safe route. Read our full coolant leak guide.

items.title: PCV Valve (Crankcase Ventilation) Failure - 60k-120k miles
items.whatHappens: The integrated PCV valve in the valve cover can fail, causing excessive crankcase pressure. Symptoms include a high-pitched whistling noise from the engine bay, rough idling, oil leaks from seals, and increased oil consumption.
items.repairVsReplace: Replacing the valve cover assembly (which includes the PCV) costs £400-£800 . This is a standard maintenance item and rarely writes off the engine block itself, making a used or reconditioned swap highly effective if caught early.

items.title: High-Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) Wear - Higher mileage examples
items.whatHappens: While vastly improved over the notorious N54/N55 HPFPs, the B58's high-pressure fuel pump can still suffer from internal wear, leading to long cranking times, lean misfire codes, and reduced power under load.
items.repairVsReplace: HPFP replacement ranges from £600-£1,200 . If the failure has caused lean running that damaged the catalytic converter or pistons, a full unit replacement is required.

failures.goodYearsLine: The B58B30M0 benefits from a closed-deck block design and a significantly more robust timing chain and fuel system than its N55 predecessor, making it one of the most reliable modern BMW inline-six engines, provided cooling system maintenance is not neglected .

variants.title: How to Confirm You Have the B58B30M0
variants.intro: ═══════════════════════════════════════ The B58B30M0 can be identified by the engine code stamped on the block (typically near the bell housing or on the front face), listed on your V5C registration document (Section D.2), or via a VIN decoder. It is most commonly confused with the updated B58B30O0 or B58B30O1, and the newer B58TU2. Fitting the wrong revision can lead to ECU mapping mismatches, incorrect turbo plumbing, and mounting point discrepancies, as the "M0" designation denotes the initial generation of the B58 architecture with specific calibration and hardware requirements.

buyingGuide.title: Buying a Replacement BMW B58B30M0 - What to Choose

options.label: Used
options.body: A used BMW B58B30M0 is a viable option for lower-value host vehicles, provided it comes with documented proof that the water pump, expansion tank, and PCV valve have been replaced within the last 20,000 miles. Without this history, the risk of inheriting a cooling system failure is elevated. Explore our vetted used engine network.

options.label: Reconditioned
options.body: This is the most recommended route for the B58B30M0. A proper reconditioning process will systematically replace the water pump, PCV valve cover, and all ancillary gaskets, directly addressing the engine's most common failure points while restoring factory compression. View reconditioned BMW B58B30M0 options.

options.label: Rebuilt
options.body: A full rebuild is justified if the host vehicle is a higher-mileage M340i, M440i, or X5 where long-term ownership or high-performance tuning is planned. An upgraded rebuild should include a reinforced cooling system, updated HPFP, and a remapped ECU to ensure longevity under increased boost. Compare rebuilt BMW B58B30M0 specialists.

buyingGuide.supplyFitLine: Choosing a supply-and-fit service through our network ensures the engine is installed by a specialist familiar with the B58's modern electronics and cooling system bleeding procedures, backed by a nationwide warranty. Learn more about supply and fit.
buyingGuide.vehicleValueNote: The B58B30M0 is typically found in vehicles valued between £15,000 and £45,000. Because a full reconditioned replacement can cost upwards of £4,450 fitted, the replacement cost is generally well within the vehicle's value, making it a financially viable repair for almost all hosts .
